question: Should assistant-message plain-text copy be implemented as an inline Markdown/plain-text copy menu, a persisted default-copy-format preference, or a smaller one-shot plain-text action?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the issue explicitly proposes multiple UX shapes and the conversion contract affects how users expect code blocks, links, tables, and lists to paste.

options.title: Copy Menu
options.body: Add a compact copy button menu with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text actions, leaving any default-format preference for a later decision.

options.title: Persisted Preference
options.body: Add a default copy-format preference and keep the message copy button as a single action, accepting the extra settings and i18n surface.

options.title: Decline Core Change
options.body: Keep the Markdown-only copy behavior and close the request as out of scope for the Control UI.

recommendation.title: Copy Menu
recommendation.body: Add a compact copy button menu with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text actions, leaving any default-format preference for a later decision.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the original copy-as-markdown behavior and have recent adjacent Control UI chat maintenance history.
